spec.title: Add discovery session button to Tasks view
spec.context: The KANBAN TASKS view currently has a + button for creating tasks, but there is no way to start a discovery session from the sidebar. Users must know the /kanban-discover slash command. Adding a discovery button makes the workflow more discoverable and accessible.

in-scope.item: Add comment-discussion icon button to KANBAN TASKS view header
Register kanban.startDiscovery command with descriptive title
Command handler opens terminal and runs /kanban-discover
Update existing createTask command title to be more descriptive
Button ordering: discovery first, then create, then refresh

out-of-scope.item: Custom markdown tooltips (using standard VSCode command titles instead)
Changes to the kanban-discover skill itself

requirements.requirement: The system shall display a comment-discussion icon button in the KANBAN TASKS view header
The discovery button shall appear before the existing + (create task) button
Clicking the discovery button shall open a terminal and execute the /kanban-discover command
The discovery command title shall be "Kanban: Start Discovery - Explore questions through Socratic Q&A"
The create task command title shall be updated to "Kanban: Create Task - Capture problem, value, and acceptance criteria"
The discovery button shall use ThemeIcon to adapt to light/dark themes
The discovery command shall be accessible via the command palette

files.file: Add kanban.startDiscovery command definition and view/title menu entry, update createTask title

patterns.pattern: Commands defined in package.json contributes.commands with icon using $(icon-name) syntax. Reference: apps/vscode/package.json:63-95
Header buttons configured in contributes.menus.view/title with group: "navigation@N" for ordering. Reference: apps/vscode/package.json:98-109
Commands run via terminal.createFreshTerminal() and terminal.sendCommand() with claude prefix. Reference: apps/vscode/src/extension.ts:260-265

product.finding: View header has existing + button at navigation@1, refresh at navigation@2. Actions execute commands in terminal.

engineering.finding: Three-layer architecture: orchestrator (extension.ts), capabilities, computers. Commands registered in orchestrator.

codebase.finding: Existing kanban.createTask command shows pattern: prompt for input, create terminal, send command.
Menu ordering uses group: "navigation@N" where lower N appears first.

pitfalls.finding: VSCode view/title buttons don't support markdown tooltips natively - using descriptive command titles instead.

constraints.constraint: Must use ThemeIcon ($(comment-discussion)) for theme compatibility
Must follow existing command registration pattern in extension.ts
Button must be accessible via command palette per design directive P5

risks.risk: Icon may not exist in older VSCode versions
